design.motion: Continuous slow-rotation or shifting on the cosmic background elements. Typography should use subtle fade-in and upward slide reveals; the 'See Works' button should have a magnetic hover effect.
design.centerpiece: A massive, high-contrast celestial vortex or cosmic eye graphic that frames the top of the content area.
design.layout: A vertically centered, symmetrical stack within a container rounded off the screen's edges. The layout utilizes a 'floating' top navigation bar and a bottom scroll indicator to anchor the vast central void.
guardrails: Avoid vibrant colors like red or green; stick to the cool galactic spectrum.
Do not use standard sans-serif weights for the main title; it must be serif and italicized.
Avoid harsh corners; use high border-radius on all UI elements like the navigation bar and primary buttons.
Do not crowd the center; keep the typography vertically stacked with generous negative space.
design.mood: Ethereal, cinematic, and sophisticated, channeling a 'scholar-in-space' aesthetic.

typography.body: Inter or Helvetica Neue, Regular, 14px tracking for readability.
typography.mono: Space Mono or JetBrains Mono for small uppercase tags like 'COLLECTION' and 'SCROLL'.
typography.display: Cormorant Garamond or Editorial New, Italic for the hero name.
